findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: The wood present at the bar behind the hand sink and along the bar in various places is observed to be unsealed. Ensure a layer of paint or sealant is placed on the bare wood present to make the material smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The external surfaces of the water gun are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris. This item is going to be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: The ice scoop was observed to be stored on a towel on top of the ice machine. THis item was washed, rinsed, and sanitized during the inspection and education was provided for proper scoop storage. Ice scoop may be stored in a clean container on top of the machine or it may be stored inside the ice machine with the handle above the ice. Ensure these practices continue to prevent contamination of the ice scoop.
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: The walk-in cooler floor as observed to be in need of repair as it is in a state of determination and not sealed properly. Ensure a plan gets in place for this surface to be repaired for it to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. This repair will be evaluated during the 2023 inspection.
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
There was food leftover from a private party last night and condiments in the walk-in cooler.  All food inconsistent with the low risk permit issued to the bar was discarded to correct the violation.

750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There was no thermometer for the pizza freezer.  Obtain a thermometer for the freezer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
There is a gap between the handsink behind the bar and the wall.  Seal the gap.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The pizza oven was soiled.  Wash, rinse, and sanitize the oven rack and drip tray.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
A dumpster lid was open.  It was closed to CORRECT the violation.

750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the bar 3-pan sink was moldy.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
